name: Happy
description: Founded at just 17 while still in college, HappyLabs was a design studio born out of passion and bold ambition. It quickly evolved into a full-fledged branding and marketing agency, onboarding clients like Pricol, Suguna, LMW, Asian Paints, MRF Racing, and Decathlon.

name: Episode Technologies
description: A software services company specializing in custom development, web applications, and strategic tech partnerships to deliver scalable enterprise solutions.

name: Stage Sight
description: A venture dedicated to live event production and experiential design. Stage Sight combines technical expertise with creative direction to deliver unforgettable live experiences for brands, institutions, and audiences.

name: Enixel
tagline: Navigating the digital landscape with strategy.
description: As digital influence surged, Enixel was built to help brands navigate the rapidly evolving social media landscape. Strategy, storytelling, and engagement became the core pillars of this new-age communication venture serving brands across India.

name: Konzept
description: Leveraging Tiruppur's knitwear ecosystem, Konzept was founded to serve the manufacturing sector. It designed, developed, and deployed athleisure uniforms for the Indian Navy — blending regional advantage with entrepreneurial foresight.

name: Karnival
description: Karnival diversified into experiential marketing with a focus on curated experiences. From corporate events to large-scale productions, this venture showcased the ability to orchestrate creativity beyond the digital and print world.

name: Pingle Infotech
description: Formed in 2024, Pingle Infotech steps into the technology and hyperlocal ecosystem — merging tech, commerce, and community-driven innovation. It reflects a continuous evolution at the intersection of digital infrastructure and real-world impact.

name: Just Kitchen
tagline: Cloud kitchen brands built for a new era.
description: Amidst global uncertainty, Just Kitchen launched multiple cloud kitchen brands — adapting to changing consumer behaviour by entering the F&B sector with innovation, operational focus, and strong brand clarity for the modern food consumer.

name: Zamindar Kitchen
description: Launched in 2025 at Sungam, Coimbatore, Zamindar Kitchen brings together heritage-inspired culinary storytelling with contemporary dining. Rooted in local culture yet presented with modern branding — tradition meets innovation on every plate.

name: Tentellect
description: Founded in 2026, Tentellect is a next-generation data intelligence platform built to help businesses collect, analyze, and visualize data with clarity. By combining modern analytics with intuitive experiences, Tentellect empowers smarter decisions through meaningful insights.

name: Odaka
description: Launched in 2026, Odaka is a modern entertainment portal designed to bring audiences closer to the latest in movies, music, gaming, celebrities, and digital culture. With engaging content and a seamless user experience, Odaka keeps entertainment enthusiasts connected every day.

name: Zircle
tagline: Capture, connect, and share your world.
description: Founded in 2026, Zircle is a photo sharing platform built for creators and communities to showcase moments, discover inspiring visuals, and connect through photography. With a clean, social-first experience, Zircle makes sharing memories effortless.
